findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "autocomplete_location" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Look up property areas (city, suburb, urbanisation, or a group of areas such as a region or a coast) by free-text name. Returns up to 10 matches with id, name, …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
